name: gamenet_respawn_player_and_drop_weapon_pickup_if_allowed
description: GameNet::RespawnPlayerAndDropWeaponPickupIfAllowed chooses a network respawn point, optionally drops the current weapon pickup, resets transient player state, and updates mission vehicle unlock flags.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the coherent GameNet/player/pickup source-cluster pass.

The smokes cover the color-indexed respawn path, race-mode no-spawn path, and final reset/unlock side effects; Binary Ninja assembly plus functional targets for Pickup::FindDroppableTypeForPlayerCurrentWeapon, Pickup::SpawnFromParsedZrdEntry, Pickup::SendPkt11_CreateDelta, and GameNet::GetNearestOtherPlayerDistanceToSpawnPoint cover the non-race pickup-drop and least-crowded-spawn paths.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x433840 validates ECX as zUtil_SaveGameState*, EDX as the color-indexed-spawn selector, player state from saveState->playerState at +0x04, local color index from GameNet::GetLocalPlayerColorIndexOrZero, color-indexed traversal of g_GameNetSpawnPointHead, optional pickup drop when race checkpoint mode is clear, least-crowded spawn selection by maximizing GameNet::GetNearestOtherPlayerDistanceToSpawnPoint results, yaw conversion from degrees to radians, and final calls to Player::SetWorldPoseAndRestartAnchor, Player::ResetMouseControlStateAndRecenterCursor, Player::ResetMotionTransientState, HudSensorTracker::GetMissionId, and Player::IsMissionProbeType1EnabledById.

The native smokes verify color-indexed spawn selection, race-mode spawn suppression, world pose/restart yaw update, previous-transform position update, mouse recenter delegation, transient motion/input clears, third-person camera offset clears, and mission-id-derived amphib/hover/sub unlock flag updates.
